text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So much for my grand ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For all that I strove to demonstrate<n>my Emperor's
strength, I have<n>nothing to show for it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're right. So long as my pride<n>remains
unbroken, the crowd may still<n>place their hopes in
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will enter the Arima Kinen... and in<n>that crucible of
ambitions, I will finally<n>make my mark.
choice_data_list: I know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your faith will be the lamp<n>that lights
my way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I will continue forth, no matter<n>what obstacles
present themselves<n>before me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As we resolve to fix our sights on the<n>Arima
Kinen...
I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good work out there, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian. It's not often you come to<n>watch me
race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I was interested in seeing who the<n>strongest
Umamusume was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Shame about how it turned out. How<n>does it feel to
be toppled from your<n>throne?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Surprisingly refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Putting on a brave face, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Emperor's Comeback would<n>make a rather
good headline, don't<n>you think?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nothing fazes you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go toe-to-toe with you<n>someday. You
look like an opponent<n>worth sinking my teeth into.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By all means. I'm confident I can<n>weather a gentle
nibble.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough of that. Is Air<n>Groove not with
you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was egotistical of me to<n>assume that
she would be watching...<n>Or could it be that she
has something<n>to attend to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You know, probing people isn't really<n>your speed.
You make it too obvious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's not what I—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you worried she won't follow<n>you if you
don't keep an eye on her?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Never mind. Anyway, you did good<n>today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Get yourself some rest. You've<n>earned it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You know, Trainer... About what Brian<n>just said—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'm from the newspaper.<n>Do you
have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. Just give me a moment to<n>get ready.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We can pick this up later. The press is<n>calling.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am certain they will be excited to<n>hear what the
Emperor will do<n>following her defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, however, Symboli Rudolf<n>winds up
swamped with interviews,<n>and we never get the
chance to have<n>that talk.
